statements.status_notes: CVE-2017-16232 reports memory leaks in LibTIFF 4.0.8 (tif_open.c, tif_lzw.c and tif_aux.c), demonstrated with the tiff2bw tool: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2017-16232. The CVE record is tagged disputed because third parties could not reproduce it. A LibTIFF maintainer replied that he saw no memory leak in the library, only memory that tiff2bw never released and a memory-based denial of service in tiff2bw itself (https://www.openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2017/11/01/7), and changed tiff2bw to free its memory in https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/commit/25f9ffa56548c1846c4a1f19308b7f561f7b1ab0, which is in LibTIFF 4.0.9 and in the 4.7.0 this package ships. Debian notes that this is only a partial fix and that upstream will not fix the remaining high memory use. Pending: SUSE rates its tiff packages affected or already fixed for this CVE (https://www.suse.com/security/cve/CVE-2017-16232/), so publishing this owner as NOT_AFFECTED on the maintainer's ruling, or as FIXED by that commit, needs a maintainer decision.
